# Nordic Visitor

> > Nordic Visitor offers curated self-drive tours, train journeys, and guided travel packages across Iceland, Scandinavia, Scotland, Ireland, and the Alps region.

Nordic Visitor specializes in independent travel experiences throughout Northern Europe and the Alps, featuring self-drive tours through Swiss Alps and Italian lakes, scenic train journeys on routes like the Glacier Express, and comprehensive travel guides covering destinations from Iceland's Ring Road to Scotland's Highlands. The site provides detailed itineraries, destination guides, and travel inspiration through customer stories and expert advice.

## Key Topics

- Self-drive tours
- Swiss Alps
- Iceland Ring Road
- Scotland Highlands
- Scandinavia travel
- Alps region (Switzerland, Austria, Germany, Italy)
- Train journeys (Glacier Express)
- Norway fjords
- Edinburgh & Royal Mile
- Northern Lights experiences
- UNESCO heritage sites
- Outdoor activities & hiking
- Summer travel planning
- Road trip itineraries
- Independent travel packages

- [21-Day Independent : Panoramic Train Journey across Europe](https://www.nordicvisitor.com/alps/train-tours/panoramic-train-journey-across-europe/2223): 21-day Glacier Express train tour across Switzerland, Italy & Austria
- [5 Amazing England, Scotland and Ireland Itinerary Ideas](https://www.nordicvisitor.com/blog/england-scotland-ireland-itinerary-ideas): Multi-country British Isles itinerary ideas for England, Scotland & Ireland
